notes.title: 🎉 New Update: Achievements Unlocked!
notes.content:
Hey Spectrunners!
We’ve just added 7 brand-new achievements to Spectrum Siege!
Whether you're a tactical mastermind, a fearless explorer, or just love a good challenge—there’s something here for you to conquer.

Jump back in, test your skills, and show the world what you’ve got!
Let me know which one you like most 👇
